verses.text: Paul, servant of God and apostle of Jesus Christ, according to di faith of God chosen people and di knowledge of di truth wey follow fear of God,
for di hope of life wey no dey end, wey God, wey no fit lie, promise before time begin;
but for im own time e show im word through di message wey dem trust me with, according to di command of God our Savior;
to Titus, my true pikin according to di faith wey we share: Grace, mercy and peace from Papa God and Christ Jesus our Savior.
Na why I leave you for Crete, so that you go put di things wey dey lack for order, and appoint elders for every city, as I direct you:
if anybody no get fault, husband of one wife, and im pikin dem believe, and nobody accuse dem say dem dey live loose or dey stubborn.

Because di overseer must no get fault, as God steward, no be person wey like im own way, no be person wey dey vex quick, no be drinker, no be person wey dey beat people, no be person wey dey greed for money,
but person wey like to welcome strangers, wey love wetin good, wey get clear mind, wey dey fair, holy and wey get self-control,
wey hold di faithful word as dem teach am, so that e go fit encourage people with di sound doctrine and show dem wey dey oppose am say dem wrong.
Because plenty stubborn men dey, wey dey talk empty talk and dey deceive people, especially dem wey dey among di circumcision,
wey must close dem mouth; dem dey spoil whole house dem, as dem dey teach wetin dem no suppose teach, for dishonest gain.
One of dem, dem own prophet, talk say, “Cretans na liars always, evil beasts and lazy people wey dey chop too much.”
Dis testimony na true. So rebuke dem sharply, so that dem go dey sound for di faith,
and no give attention to Jewish story dem wey no be true and to commandment dem of men wey turn comot from di truth.
To dem wey clean, everything dey clean, but to dem wey dirty and no believe, nothing dey clean; even dem mind and dem conscience don dirty.
Dem dey talk say dem know God, but dem deeds dey deny am, as dem dey disgusting, disobedient and no fit for any good work.
But you, talk di things wey fit di sound doctrine,
say make old men dey control demself, get sense, get clear mind, and dey sound for faith, for love and for patience:
and make old women too dey respectful for how dem dey behave, no be slanderers, no be slave to plenty wine, but teachers of wetin good;
so that dem go train di young women to love dem husbands and to love dem pikin dem,
to get clear mind, to dey pure, to work for house, to dey kind, and to submit to dem own husbands, so that people no go blaspheme God word.
Na so too, encourage di young men make dem get clear mind;
for everything, make you show example of good works; for your teaching, show honesty and seriousness,
and talk wey clean wey nobody fit condemn; so that di person wey oppose you go shame, as e no get any evil thing to talk about us.
Encourage servants make dem submit to dem own oga and make dem please dem for everything; no argue back,
no steal, but show all good faithfulness; so that for everything dem go make di doctrine of God our Savior fine.
Because God grace don show, e dey bring salvation to all men,
e dey teach us make we turn comot from way wey no dey fear God and from desire of dis world, so that we go live with clear mind, righteous and for fear of God for dis present age,
as we dey wait for di blessed hope and di appearing of di glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ;
wey give imself for us, so that e go free us from all wickedness and make clean people for imself, im own people, wey dey zealous for good works.
Talk dese things, and encourage and rebuke with all authority. Make nobody despise you.
Remind dem make dem submit to rulers and authorities, make dem obey, make dem ready for every good work,
make dem no talk evil about anybody, make dem no like quarrel, make dem dey gentle, and show all humility to all men.
Because we too before dey foolish, disobedient and deceived, as we dey serve different desire and pleasure, dey live for malice and envy, dey hateful, and dey hate each other.
But when di kindness of God our Savior and im love for people show,
no be because of righteous works wey we do, but according to im mercy, e save us through di washing wey give us new birth and through di renewing by Holy Spirit,
wey e pour on us plenty through Jesus Christ our Savior;
so that as im grace don make us righteous, we go be heirs according to di hope of life wey no dey end.
Dis saying dey true, and I want make you strongly talk dese things, so that dem wey don believe God go take care to dey do good works. Dese things good and dey useful to men;
but stay far from foolish argument, genealogy, quarrel and fight about di law; because dem no get profit and dem empty.
Reject person wey dey divide people after first and second warning;
as you know say person like dat don twist and e dey sin, and im own self don condemn am.
When I send Artemas or Tychicus come meet you, try come meet me for Nicopolis, because I don decide say I go spend di winter there.
Help Zenas di lawyer and Apollos quick for dem journey, so that nothing go lack dem.
Make our people learn too to dey do good works for wetin dem need, so that dem no go dey without fruit.
All dem wey dey with me dey greet you. Greet dem wey love us for faith. Grace dey with una all. Amen.
